title: Filing: Anthropic raised ~$3B from Japanese investors as part of its IPO, the lower end of its planned range of $3B to $3.5B (Yasutaka Tamura/Bloomberg)
summary: Yasutaka Tamura / Bloomberg: Filing: Anthropic raised ~$3B from Japanese investors as part of its IPO, the lower end of its planned range of $3B to $3.5B — Anthropic PBC raised about $3 billion from Japanese investors as part of its initial public offering, the lower end of its planned range, according to a regulatory filing on Thursday.
